newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - May 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - May 16.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

-- M16 TAKES ON RUSSIAN MAFIA In order to crack a Russian mafia conspiracy to smuggle illegal immigrants into Britain, MI6 have been called in. The scheme involves bringing migrants from China and India, via Moscow and Eastern Europe to the Channel ports.

-- ADS-BAN TALKS SNUB FOR CIGARETTE MAKERS The Tobacco Manufacturers Association have requested talks with the Department of Health over the extent of the ban on tobacco advertising outlined in Wednesday's Queen's speech.
-- NATWEST'S 'PROGRAM' FOR BIGGER SHARE OF US ACTION

NatWest markets has become a major force in the business of program trading, overtaking US 'bulge-bracket' firms in terms of daily volume and ranking number two overall. It now turns over an average of 158mn shares a day, amounting to almost 7bn US dollars (4bn stg).
